page_title: RSO 2-0 PAL | Real Sociedad v Las Palmas 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) replacing Sheraldo Becker.
87' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Odriozola departs the field of play to be replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Javi Galan.
78' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
75' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
75' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Benito Ramirez will be replaced by Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas).
73' 3:3 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
71' Substitution. Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) replaces Mika Marmol.
71' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andre Silva.
71' Here is a change. Brais Mendez is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
67' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows the yellow card to Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) for a heavy challenge.
64' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!

60' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
59' Las Palmas concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) replaces Daley Sinkgraven.
58' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) replaces Maximo Perrone.
58' Substitution. Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Munir El Haddadi walks off.
56' The game is interrupted as Marvin (Las Palmas) is flagged offside.
54' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
53' Great solo effort from Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
51' The goal by Real Sociedad won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!

51' The Real Sociedad players halt their celebrations as referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
50' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 3:0.
50' CHANCE! Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
50' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
49' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles easily deals with the threat.
49' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

47' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The opposition can't get near Marvin (Las Palmas), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Las Palmas was in an offside position.
40' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) for a tough tackle.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Marvin (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in his challenge.
33' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) puts the ball beyond his own goalkeeper to register an own goal!
33' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the whole situation.
31' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Sociedad.
29' The foul by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' Dangerous play by Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) brings an opponent down and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game.
25' Flag up against Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) is flagged for offside.
23' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. That's a free kick to Las Palmas.
21' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

20' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.
17' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias ignores the protests.
17' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

17' Alex Remiro makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. Las Palmas will take a corner kick.
14' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
13' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
11' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a set piece.
7' Marvin (Las Palmas) makes a slide tackle, but referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
3' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) heads on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
